verdict.rationale: React lets you drop into existing HTML pages and write UI declaratively (react-docs-1, react-gh-3), but it explicitly introduces JSX, a new JavaScript syntax extension, plus its own state/props model (react-docs-2, react-docs-3), meaning developers must learn new concepts beyond standard HTML/CSS/JS. Community commentary also notes React's internal model (fibers, concurrent mode) is non-trivial to grasp (react-comm-6, react-comm-7), reflecting a real learning curve rather than a pure 'use what you already know' experience. Missing for 10: evidence that plain HTML/CSS/JS suffices without JSX or hooks, and independent confirmation of minimal new-concept learning.
